text:
maria_sales: Prospective client (BlueHarbor Bank) requires BYO-KMS with HSM-proxy in their VPC. Two asks: (1) emergency rotate/new-key-in-use <= 4 minutes, (2) invoice must show HSM calls per API request. Need feasibility + SOW snippet.

eli_se: Quick clarifier 1: "new-key-in-use" for new writes only, or full revoke of old-wraps?

maria_sales: They only need new writes to use new keys within 4m; historical reads can use old keys for 24h.

noah_eng: Feasible with caveats: push new wrapping key to proxy pool, invalidate caches and optionally shorten session TTLs. Forced invalidation will cause a transient error/latency spike ~30-90s. We'll produce latency matrix for 50/200/800 rps.

kevin_sre: Runbook bullets: 1) create key in customer KMS 2) distribute to proxy nodes 3) cache-invalidate + warm new key 4) cut traffic to new key 5) monitor errors and rollback threshold. Recommend canary 45s.

anya_security: Need customer's KMS attestation, HSM tamper-evidence, and FIPS level. If they require import ceremony (M-of-N) or Level 3 FIPS, onboarding lead time increases. Also rotation events must have signed audit logs.

sara_billing: Per-call line OK. We'll add SKU BYO-HSM_CALL; need metering tag from engineering. Pricing: propose tiers ($0.0125/<500k, $0.009/500k-2M, $0.0065/>2M) or commit to reduce price.

deploy-bot: Feature-flag note: per-call metering for BYO-KMS currently behind FF: feature/metric/byo-hsm. PR #5201 pending.

eli_se: Draft SOW snippet: "Redwood will use commercially reasonable efforts to begin serving new write requests using newly-rotated keys within four (4) minutes of rotation initiation. Emergency revocation may cause transient elevated error rates; Redwood will provide signed rotation audit artifacts on request. Exceptions include network partitions and force majeure."

maria_sales: Perfect. Action items: Noah -> latency matrix, Kevin -> network template + peering vs NAT notes, Anya -> exact doc checklist, Sara -> invoice mockup. I'll book a 20m sync with BlueHarbor once we have drafts.

noah_eng: I'll post numbers in ~24h. Expect a small error spike during forced evict.

anya_security: I'll DM Maria the checklist and sample attestation PDFs.

sara_billing: I'll draft invoice example after PR lands.

maria_sales: Thanks team 44d. Ping me if blockers appear.
